crossRefs.note: Unless the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the sake of the chosen ones, whom he…
It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”
Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?
Purge out the old yeast, that you may be a new lump, even as you are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, has…
A little yeast grows through the whole lump.
Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.
But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.
Let’s acknowledge Yahweh. Let’s press on to know Yahweh. As surely as the sun rises, Yahweh will appear. He will come…
Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear…
“I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
However when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself…
being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.
This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,
For it is God who works in you both to will and to work, for his good pleasure.
May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at…
He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.
But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.

parallels.note: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”

translations.web: He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, until it was all leavened.”
translations.bsb: He told them still another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like leaven that a woman took and mixed into three measures of flour, until all of it was leavened.”
translations.kjv: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
translations.asv: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till it was all leavened.
